newsitem.title: USA: DentlCare to buy Chicago dental provider.
newsitem.headline: DentlCare to buy Chicago dental provider.

text.p: DentlCare Management Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the Chicago Denture Clinic of Chicago for undisclosed terms.

Chicago Denture Clinic, which provides general dental services with emphasis on prosthetics, reported $500,000 in gross sales for 1995 and expects $650,000 in revenues this year and more than $1 million for 1997.
With this acquisition, DentlCare, a dental practice management company, will manage 14 dental care operations.
